other_failure_modes.name: Meaningless algebraic operations on categorical variables
other_failure_modes.description: The agent performs multiplication between integer-encoded categorical variables and continuous variables. Because label encoding assigns arbitrary integers to categories, the resulting product is mathematically meaningless and only adds noise.

other_failure_modes.name: Optimizing blend weights on early-stopping validation set
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the exact same validation set for both early stopping during model training and optimizing ensemble blend weights. Since model predictions on this set are already biased by early stopping, optimizing weights on them can lead to overfitting the ensemble.
